genuine_origin.source: Diagnostic operator pulses through guarded original bridge/Pult/Tyga/POEZD; production AVP disabled, full source; no RK/permission/force output assignments

cases.limitation: Prepared reverse is a signed reset/actual-pressure mechanical component. It is not a genuine reverse driving journey or cab EDT acceptance. SI one-shoe friction is evaluated on every mechanical substep; pressure comes from actual native outer pneumatic cycles. Literature equivalent inertia and published Sh2V pair are active.

scope: Real native electrical start and physical KM V/IV service pneumatics feed accepted managed force snapshots. View, pause, replay and read-only state checks. Teaching signals/software RBS are declared fixture inputs. No release/stop, factory force/wave calibration or complete RE acceptance.
